title: DRIVE: a saturation and a low pass gate on each track
description: A master page (FUNC + LFO) that gives the active audio track a drive of its own before its filter: TAPE, TUBE, FUZZ or FOLD, with amount, tone, mix and level; and (0.5) a low pass gate after it, after VILNIS's: LP, VCA or both, struck by every hit on the track, with decay and resonance. The page draws the curve and lists the eight tracks' drives. Saved.
author: Cere, made with Claude
